{{Top}} {{Conjecture}} {{Update|[[The Mandalorian Season 2 Junior Novel|Star Wars: The Mandalorian Season 2 Junior Novel]]}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:MimbaneseSpy.png]] |name=Unidentified Mimbanese worker |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Mimbanese]]{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 12: The Siege}} |gender=[[Gender|Female]][[The Mandalorian Season 2 Junior Novel|''The Mandalorian Season 2'' Junior Novel]] |pronouns=new |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Blue]] |skin=Red |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=[[Gideon's Imperial remnant]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|I'll get my best people on it.|Greef Karga, on the Mimbanese worker|}} A [[Mimbanese]] '''worker''' served as a [[Technician|mechanic]] for the [[Magistrate]] [[Greef Karga]] while also being a [[spy]] for [[Moff]] [[Gideon]]'s [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. After being ordered to repair the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]]'s [[gunship]], the ''[[Razor Crest]]'', the worker was instructed by Gideon's remnant to plant a [[Homing beacon|tracking beacon]] in the [[starship]]. The Mimbanese complied and informed an [[Elia Kane|Imperial comms officer]] when the job had been done. ==Biography== {{Quote|Hey, fellas! Let's fix this man's ship! I want it as good as new.''"
"[Replies in alien language]''|Greef Karga and the Mimbanese worker|}} Around [[9 ABY]], the [[Mimbanese]] worker served [[Magistrate]] [[Greef Karga]] at his [[Nevarro City|city]] on the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]] as a [[technician]], even being called by Karga as one of "his best men." Simultaneously, however, the worker operated as a [[spy]] for [[Moff]] [[Gideon]], the leader of a [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. When the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]] arrived to meet with Karga and the [[city]] [[Marshal]] [[Carasynthia Dune|Cara Dune]], Karga ordered the Mimbanese and another worker to repair the Mandalorian's [[gunship]], the ''[[Razor Crest]]''. The Mimbanese worker acknowledged Karga's orders, beginning to work immediately, and looked back towards Djarin and his [[foundling]], [[Din Grogu|Grogu]], as they entered the city. [[File:Mimbanese-snitches.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Mimbanese worker informs the comms officer about the tracking beacon.]] The Mimbanese made contact with Gideon's remnant, confirming the presence of Grogu, which Gideon had been searching for. The worker was made to place a [[Homing beacon|tracking beacon]] on the ''Razor Crest'' during repairs, and after the work was finished, Djarin departed Nevarro. The Mimbanese soon contacted Gideon's remnant again, informing [[Communications officer|comms officer]] [[Elia Kane]] that a tracking beacon had been placed aboard the ''Razor Crest''. The [[Imperial officer]] promised that the worker would be rewarded during the "new era." ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Does he still have the asset?''"
"''Yes. Our source confirmed it.|Gideon and a comms officer|}} The Mimbanese worker had [[Color|red]] skin and blue [[eye]]s. The worker compliantly followed orders from both Greef Karga and Moff Gideon's remnant, giving the latter updates. ==Equipment== {{Quote|What do you have for me?''"
"''The device has been planted, as you requested.''"
"''Good. You'll be well-rewarded in the new era.|The worker and a comms officer|}} The Mimbanese wore a headset and leather straps around the head and also [[Clothing|donned]] a [[Color|yellow]] jacket. The worker also possessed tools which were carried at the beginning of the repairs. ==Behind the scenes== The Mimbanese worker appeared in "[[Chapter 12: The Siege]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Carl Weathers]] and released on [[November 20]], [[2020]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-november-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in November 2020}} Credited as "Alien Worker," the worker was played by [[Ryan Powers]]. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of unidentified Mimbanese worker}} *[[The Mandalorian Season 2 Junior Novel|''The Mandalorian Season 2'' Junior Novel]] *[[The Mandalorian – The Graphic Novel of Season 2|''The Mandalorian'' – The Graphic Novel of Season 2]] *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 12: The Siege}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/the-mandalorian/chapter-12-guide|text="The Siege" Episode Guide | The Mandalorian}} *{{SWYouTube|tGk3PkqLOOM|Season 2 Recap Sizzle | The Mandalorian | Disney+|sw_url=video/season-2-recap-sizzle-the-mandalorian}} *{{DisneyGallery|Disney Gallery: The Mandalorian: Making of Season Two|Making of Season Two}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Trabajador mimbanés no identificado |ja=名称不明のミンバニーズ労働者 |ka=უცნობი მიმბანელი მუშაკი |pl=Mechanik (Nevarro) }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Information brokers]] [[Category:Mechanics]] [[Category:Members of Gideon's Imperial remnant]] [[Category:Mimbanese]] [[Category:Personnel of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Spies]]
